title: Amazon says: $749 charge pending
scenario: A text and a follow-up call claim a $749 order just went through on your Amazon account. The message gives a phone number to call immediately to cancel before it ships.

answers.A: Open the Amazon app yourself and check your orders; call Amazon only through the number in the app if anything looks wrong.
answers.B: Call the number in the text to cancel the order before it ships.
answers.C: Stay on the line and read back the verification code they send to your phone.

explanation: Real order alerts don't need you to call an unfamiliar number to cancel. The call is the scam - it moves you from a text into a live agent who asks for account access.
proTip: Check orders inside the app you already trust, not through a number a message gives you.
